query: ALTER TABLE container_registry_manifest_blob ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_manifest_blob_chk_sha_manifest_digest CHECK(manifest_digest ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_manifest_blob_chk_sha_layer_blob CHECK(blob_digest ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_manifest_blob_fk_manifest_digest FOREIGN KEY(manifest_digest) REFERENCES container_registry_manifest(digest), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_manifest_blob_fk_blob_digest FOREIGN KEY(blob_digest) REFERENCES container_registry_blob(digest);
